description: Polyphonic attack and decay envelope with some of the features of the Buchla 281. The number of voices is the smaller of the channels arriving at the trigger input and the count set in the menu

params.text: The rise time, from 0 to 10 seconds
The fall time, from 0 to 10 seconds
Scales the envelope from -2 to +2, so negative settings turn it upside down
Bends the shape of both stages between straight and exponential
Makes the envelope start itself again as soon as it finishes, so it runs as an LFO

inputs.text: A voltage added to the rise time; a negative voltage is subtracted from it
A voltage added to the fall time; a negative voltage is subtracted from it

outputs.text: Fires when the envelope reaches the end of its cycle

menu: Paraphonic mode — leaves the number of voices to the polyphony menu and sends the first envelope to every one of them
Polyphony channels — sets the greatest number of voices the module runs; the number actually run is the smaller of this and the channels arriving at the trigger input
